name: PCP from 2D Histograms
definition: A method to separate the number of polylines to render from the number of data samples by generating the PCP from 2D histograms of adjacent variable pairs, and outliers are also identified through histogram analysis.
summary: PCP from 2D Histograms generates parallel coordinate plots by aggregating data into histograms, separating polyline count from sample size to reduce over-plotting and rendering costs.
